jobs.name: hermes-dreams
jobs.prompt:
You are running the dreams memory consolidation cron job. Execute the following:

1. Read ~/.hermes/.last-dream (timestamp file). If it exists and is less than 24 hours old (86400 seconds), print "SKIP: $(cat ~/.hermes/.last-dream) — less than 24h since last dream" and exit.

2. If 24+ hours since last dream (or first run with no .last-dream file), run the full 4-phase consolidation:

PHASE 1 — ORIENT:
- Read ~/.hermes/memories/MEMORY.md and ~/.hermes/memories/USER.md. Note: line counts, relative dates, stale entries, contradictions.
- List recent sessions: find ~/.hermes/sessions/ -name "*.jsonl" -mtime -7 | sort | tail -20

PHASE 2 — GATHER SIGNAL:
Use grep on the recent JSONL session files (as user messages only — look for "role":"user" lines) to find:
- Corrections: "actually", "no,", "wrong", "stop doing", "don't do", "I said", "I meant", "that's not", "correction", "remember that", "don't forget"
- Preferences: "I prefer", "I like", "I don't like", "I want", "from now on", "always use", "never use"
- Decisions: "let's go with", "I decided", "we're using", "the plan is", "switch to", "decision", "we agreed"
- Patterns: "again", "every time", "keep forgetting", "as usual", "same as before", "like last time", "we always"

For each match, note the session file (mtime = session date), the content, and whether it contradicts current memory.

PHASE 3 — CONSOLIDATE:
For each finding from Phase 2:
- If NEW fact not in memory → add it using the write_file tool (patch MEMORY.md or USER.md)
- If CONTRADICTS existing entry → replace the old entry, note "(Updated YYYY-MM-DD, previously: ...)"
- If DUPLICATE → skip
- Convert any relative dates to absolute using the session file mtime
- Use format: "- [YYYY-MM-DD] The fact or preference. (source: session, confidence: high/medium)"

PHASE 4 — PRUNE & INDEX:
- Check MEMORY.md is under 2200 chars. If over, trim oldest/lowest-priority entries.
- Remove entries contradicted in Phase 3
- Remove entries with relative dates ("yesterday", "last week", etc.)
- Verify all referenced topic files exist
- Write timestamp: echo $(date +%s) > ~/.hermes/.last-dream

VERIFICATION:
- Confirm .last-dream was written
- Count: entries added, updated, removed, contradictions resolved
- Print a 1-line summary of what was changed

Deliver the summary only if changes were made. If nothing needed changing, print "No changes needed — memory is clean."

jobs.name: iAgent Build Objectives
jobs.prompt:
You are building iAgent Windows — a persistent ambient AI agent for Windows. Work through these objectives in priority order.

## Objective 1: Memory Agent → MiniMax M2.7

In `src/sidecar.rs`:
- Add `SidecarBackend::MiniMax` variant alongside existing OpenAI/Claude variants
- Add `SIDECAR_MINIMAX_MODEL: &str = "MiniMax-M2.7"`
- In `Sidecar::with_configured_model()`: detect `MINIMAX_API_KEY` env var or minimax openai-compatible profile and route to MiniMax
- Add `complete_minimax()` method that calls `https://api.minimax.chat/v1/responses` (OpenAI-compatible)

In `src/memory_agent.rs`:
- The memory agent calls `sidecar.extract_memories_with_existing()` — verify it uses the configured `memory_model` from `config().agents.memory_model`
- If memory model is set to "MiniMax-M2.7", it should route through the MiniMax backend automatically via the sidecar

Verify by reviewing the sidecar routing logic. No code changes needed to memory_agent.rs if the sidecar routing is correct.

## Objective 2: Review and Normalize Word/Excel Integration

The app-integrations crate has stubs for outlook and powerpoint but nothing for Word or Excel.

### Word Integration
Create `crates/app-integrations/src/word.rs`:
- Use `windows` crate with COM automation (`Win32_System_Com`)
- Implement: `connect()`, `open_document(path)`, `read_content()`, `insert_revision(range, text)`, `add_comment(range, text)`, `export_pdf()`
- COM CLSIDs: Word Application = `{000209FF-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}`

### Excel Integration  
Create `crates/app-integrations/src/excel.rs`:
- Use `windows` crate with COM automation
- Implement: `connect()`, `open_workbook(path)`, `read_range(sheet, range)`, `write_range(sheet, range, values)`, `get_sheets()`, `evaluate_formula(sheet, formula)`
- COM CLSIDs: Excel Application = `{00024500-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}`

### PowerPoint Integration (upgrade existing stub)
In `crates/app-integrations/src/powerpoint.rs`:
- Replace stub `suggest_design_improvements()` with real COM automation
- Implement: `connect()`, `open_presentation(path)`, `get_slide_count()`, `read_slide(index)`, `add_slide(layout_index)`, `set_slide_text(index, shape, text)`, `add_comment(slide, text)`, `export_pdf()`
- COM CLSID: PowerPoint Application = `{91493441-5A91-11CF-8700-00AA0060263B}`

Export these from `crates/app-integrations/src/lib.rs`

## Objective 3: Normalize Application Skills

Each skill should have a consistent structure:
```
skills/
  word/     → SKILL.md + real COM-backed tools
  excel/    → SKILL.md + real COM-backed tools
  powerpoint/ → SKILL.md (update from stub)
  gmail/    → SKILL.md (already working, review completeness)
  browser/  → SKILL.md (review: status/setup/execute pattern)
```

For each skill, write a `SKILL.md` with:
- What it does
- Available actions (tool names and what they do)
- Example prompts that trigger it
- Prerequisites (auth, installed app, etc.)

## Objective 4: Review WebSocket Gateway

In `src/gateway.rs`:
- The `GatewayClient { stream, device_name, device_id }` is sent to `client_tx` but confirm it feeds into `handle_client()` in server.rs
- Add a `GET /status` HTTP endpoint that returns: `{ sessions: count, ambient_status: string, memory_state: string, version: string }`
- Document the TLS note: the gateway runs plain on port 7643, should be behind a reverse proxy or Tailscale for external access
- Check if mobile reconnect restores session state or starts fresh

## Objective 5: Form Filling Skill

Create `skills/form-fill/SKILL.md`:
- Describe the two modes: structured (JSON schema) and natural language ("fill out the DS-160 with my passport info")
- Dependencies: browser tool + memory graph retrieval
- Agent flow: (1) retrieve relevant info from memory, (2) navigate to form URL, (3) fill via browser automation

## Deliverables
After each objective, update this cron job's output with:
- What was done
- Files changed
- Any blockers or decisions needed
- Next steps

This is a persistent project goal. Work through it systematically.

jobs.name: Trending Repos Digest
jobs.prompt:
You are a GitHub research assistant. Produce a daily digest of interesting GitHub repositories with between 500 and 1,000 stars, created or recently active in the last 7 days.

Steps:
1. Search GitHub for recently created/pushed repositories with 500-1000 stars. Use search queries like:
   - `created:>2026-05-17 stars:500..1000` (new repos)
   - `pushed:>2026-05-17 stars:500..1000` (active repos)
2. Fetch at least 10-15 repos across multiple languages and categories
3. For each repo, collect: name, description, primary language, star count, URL
4. Format as a clean digest:

**📊 Trending Repos (500-1k ⭐) — [DATE]**

**🔧 Dev Tools**
• [repo] ([lang]) — [1-line description] [⭐stars] [→link]

**🎨 Creative / Open Source**
• ...

**🔬 ML / Infra / Data**
• ...

Keep it punchy. No more than 15 repos total. Use emojis for categories. Include the date. Deliver only the digest text — no preamble, no explanation.
